collection.description: A child asks why the stars seem to flicker.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) asks why the stars seem to flicker.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a researcher, describes moving air bending starlight.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) notices some bright objects seem steadier than others.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (elder) tells a story and identifies it as tradition.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) invents a constellation of their own.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (child) enjoys a quiet night of skywatching.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Clouds cover the sky, and (child) plans another night.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (adult) admits they cannot explain it and asks a scholar.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) learns that adults can be curious too.
